/* ============================================================
   GRIDPULSE AI — PHASE 5
   Current Real-Time DQ State
   Read-only inspection
   ============================================================ */

fn_rt_dq_summary()
| project
    rule_id,
    rule_name,
    severity,
    status,
    metric_value,
    evaluated_at_utc
| order by rule_id asc;

tabs.content:
/* ============================================================
   GRIDPULSE AI — PHASE 5
   Validate investigate_market_event RT metrics backbone

   Uses:
   fn_rt_price_market_metrics()

   No raw-table calculations.
   ============================================================ */


/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   1. Pick one real market-metrics row dynamically
   ------------------------------------------------------------ */

let sample =
    fn_rt_price_market_metrics()
    | top 1 by delivery_date desc, delivery_hour desc, interval_no desc
    | project delivery_date, delivery_hour, interval_no;


/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   2. Retrieve complete deterministic context for that key
   ------------------------------------------------------------ */

fn_rt_price_market_metrics()
| where delivery_date == toscalar(sample | project delivery_date)
| where delivery_hour == toscalar(sample | project delivery_hour)
| where interval_no == toscalar(sample | project interval_no)
| project
    delivery_date,
    delivery_hour,
    interval_no,

    price,
    previous_price,
    slot_gap,
    interval_price_change,
    is_negative_price,

    rolling_15_complete,
    rolling_15_avg,
    rolling_15_min,
    rolling_15_max,
    rolling_15_stddev,
    negative_15_count,
    negative_15_share,

    rolling_30_complete,
    rolling_30_avg,
    rolling_30_min,
    rolling_30_max,
    rolling_30_stddev,
    negative_30_count,
    negative_30_share,

    rolling_60_complete,
    rolling_60_avg,
    rolling_60_min,
    rolling_60_max,
    rolling_60_stddev,
    negative_60_count,
    negative_60_share,

    event_id,
    source_hash,
    event_created_at_utc;


/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   3. Verify uniqueness for the selected business key
   ------------------------------------------------------------ */

fn_rt_price_market_metrics()
| where delivery_date == toscalar(sample | project delivery_date)
| where delivery_hour == toscalar(sample | project delivery_hour)
| where interval_no == toscalar(sample | project interval_no)
| summarize row_count = count();


/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   4. Inspect rolling-window completeness distribution
   ------------------------------------------------------------ */

fn_rt_price_market_metrics()
| summarize
    row_count = count(),
    rolling_15_complete_rows = countif(rolling_15_complete == true),
    rolling_15_incomplete_rows = countif(rolling_15_complete == false),

    rolling_30_complete_rows = countif(rolling_30_complete == true),
    rolling_30_incomplete_rows = countif(rolling_30_complete == false),

    rolling_60_complete_rows = countif(rolling_60_complete == true),
    rolling_60_incomplete_rows = countif(rolling_60_complete == false);


/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   5. Verify gap-safe price-change behavior

   Any row returned here requires investigation:
   a price change should not be treated as valid if the
   preceding logical market slot is not adjacent.
   ------------------------------------------------------------ */

fn_rt_price_market_metrics()
| where slot_gap != 1
| where isnotnull(interval_price_change)
| project
    delivery_date,
    delivery_hour,
    interval_no,
    price,
    previous_price,
    slot_gap,
    interval_price_change;


/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   6. Missing business key must return no market metrics
   ------------------------------------------------------------ */

fn_rt_price_market_metrics()
| where delivery_date == "1900-01-01"
| where delivery_hour == 18
| where interval_no == 7
| summarize row_count = count();
